title: SettingsDescribe
description: Result of the settings.describe JSON-RPC method. The single declaration of this shape: the renderer's TypeScript type is generated from it and the Go transport is validated against it.

declarations.description: Every declared setting, in declaration order.

groups.description: The settings rail's group catalogue — id, title, order — in rail order. Component pages name these ids in their registry entries in settings.tsx; a page whose group id is absent here is a defect, never a silent top-level page.

sectionGroups.description: Which group each generated section belongs to. A section absent from this map is ungrouped and renders at top level beside the groups. Keyed by section, never by declaration: two declarations in one section cannot disagree about their group.

section.description: Group heading in the UI. The section is what a rail group maps, never the individual declaration.

default.description: The declared default. Path-list settings use an array of strings; scalar settings use their scalar value. Absent for secret-class settings and for zero-value scalar defaults (the Go wire omits them via omitempty).

options.description: The select control's choices; present only for control: select.

id.description: Stable id a component page names in its registry entry.

order.description: Rail position; the rail sorts groups by it. Distinct per group.
